newsitem.title: USA: MatriDigm unveils Yr 2000 product, sets expansion.
newsitem.headline: MatriDigm unveils Yr 2000 product, sets expansion.

text.p: MatriDigm Corp Monday unveiled its MatriDigm Advanced Process 2000 Service, or MAP2000, an automated date reconstruction system that will find, fix software problems related to the Year 2000 glitch.

Many older computers and software programs, unable to process two-digit dates correctly after December 31, 1999, could crash on January 1, 2000, while many other will think the date is Jauary 1, 1900.
The company announced plans for expansion through relocation of its corporate headquarters and development of a new, larger factory facility.

A new 44,000 square foot facility in San Jose, California will house the growing technical and factory teams. In addition, an 18,000 square foot corporate headquarters is being established in Denver, Colorado. The firm expects to migrate to both facilities in the first quarter of 1997.
Zitel Corp owns a stake in Matridigm. In October, Zitel said it owned 35 percent of the software firm.
